  1. Must see · Southern Ridges

    Southern Ridges & Henderson Waves

    10 km of ridge-top trails linking Mount Faber, Telok Blangah & Kent Ridge, crossing the wave-form Henderson Waves, Singapore's highest pedestrian bridge.

    Look for Nature

    Henderson Road, Mount Faber / Telok Blangah

    Recommended by NParks (National Parks Board), Wikipedia (English)

  2. Must see · Southern Ridges

    Haw Par Villa

    1937 cultural theme park (ex-Tiger Balm Garden) of surreal dioramas, famed for the Ten Courts of Hell.

    Look for Landmark

    262 Pasir Panjang Road

    Recommended by Visit Singapore (Singapore Tourism Board), Wikipedia (English)
